headline.text: L3 ML4 Sweco screen *torn with embedded particles* — cleaning complete but damaged screen cannot be assembled, blocks Monday startup until replacement installed.

summary: One high-priority issue: L3 ML4 north Sweco screen damaged with embedded foreign material, blocks startup until replacement available Monday. L1 S3 had four allergen verification failures during cleaning — three areas recleaned, Z belt still open for Monday rework. Two equipment foreign-material risks at L3 (broken mixer blade, cracked tablet) both removed during cleaning.

food_safety.title: North Sweco screen damaged, cannot be assembled
food_safety.summary: North Sweco screen has tear and embedded dark particles that cannot be removed; ATP passed but screen cannot be used — blocks Monday startup until replacement screen installed and verified.
food_safety.status: Open — screen cleaned and covered, Sweco power off, replacement needed first thing Monday before temper unit 2 can start.

food_safety.title: Cracked tablet screen removed from depositor area
food_safety.summary: Tablet with cracked screen found at depositor 4 removed to office to prevent glass or plastic brittle contamination risk.
food_safety.status: Resolved — tablet removed from production floor and stored in Rose's office.

food_safety.title: Depositor 2 mixer blade broken at attachment point
food_safety.summary: Mixer blade in depositor 2 broke at weld point during cleaning; maintenance exchanged with spare from another depositor to eliminate metal fragment risk.
food_safety.status: Resolved — broken mixer replaced with spare, damaged unit removed from line.

quality.title: Pouch piece count initially out of spec
quality.summary: S2 startup showed 58 pieces per pouch against max spec of 55; piece weights adjusted, later checks showed 52-54 pieces within target range of 54 min.
quality.status: Resolved — weights adjusted during startup, pouch counts within spec by end of shift.

quality.title: CPK caramels slip sheet spec discrepancy
quality.summary: Spec calls for slip sheets (40711) but tray design requires die-cut tie sheets (40746); team used correct physical sheets but spec documentation may need updating.
quality.status: Open — spec review needed to confirm correct part number for CPK tray stacking pattern.

sanitation.title: Three areas failed initial allergen verification on S3
sanitation.summary: Decorator 4 (2 failures), Z belt in pack (2 failures), and target depositor initially failed allergen swabs; decorator and depositor passed after recleaning, Z belt still failed and scheduled for rework Monday.
sanitation.status: Open — Z belt in pack failed re-clean, will be recleaned Monday; decorator 4 and target depositor passed after second clean.

sanitation.title: Inclusion belt and hopper failed allergen test on S3
sanitation.summary: Inclusion belt and hopper failed allergen verification on overnight shift, likely insufficient rinse; re-soaped and rinsed by sanitation team.
sanitation.status: Investigation ongoing — re-cleaned per sanitation lead, final test results not posted in window.

sanitation.title: ML4 shutdown procedures skipped
sanitation.summary: Both compressors off, WDS not in night mode, heater and FSC left on, scraper valve left open — shutdown checklist not completed by second shift.
sanitation.status: Resolved on shift — third shift corrected compressors, WDS mode, valve, and FSC settings.

sanitation.title: Depositor discharge area left uncleaned
sanitation.summary: Barrel overflow on scraper and licking roller discharge pipe left by first shift for second shift to address during level 2 clean.
sanitation.status: Resolved — cleaned during level 2 clean, shift lead will address handoff gap Monday.

opportunities.text: Consider adding rinse-verification checkpoint to S3 allergen cleaning SOPs — based on inclusion belt/hopper and Z belt failures both attributed to insufficient rinsing during tonight's cleaning.
Review depositor mixer blade inspection frequency — based on today's broken blade at ML4 depositor 2 weld point discovered during cleaning.
Formalize Sweco screen inspection during ML4 cleaning cycle — based on torn screen with embedded particles at north Sweco that went undetected until ATP stage.
Add shutdown checklist sign-off requirement for ML4 — based on compressors, WDS mode, scraper valve, and FSC all missed in tonight's handoff.
